Dear Ankit Ji,

Thank you for the time last week — and for reconnecting. As promised, here is the updated scope document incorporating everything we discussed, including the WhatsApp group feature that wasn't in the September 2025 proposal.

Updated Scope for Ambit Biomedix

Customer Communication via WhatsApp (SFTP Integration)
Your invoices, credit notes, and ledger files are placed in a shared SFTP folder by your billing system → ZoTok automatically picks them up → reads the customer details → sends the relevant document to the right customer on WhatsApp. No manual effort from your team after setup.

Payment reminders: based on invoice due dates read from the SFTP folder, ZoTok sends automated payment reminders to customers on WhatsApp at configured intervals.

Customer self-service: customer types "my invoice" or "my outstanding" in a conversation with your WABA number → AI fetches and sends the relevant documents instantly.

WhatsApp Group Order Capture (New — Added to Scope)
Your sales team and customers already communicate on WhatsApp groups. ZoTok adds an AI listener to those groups:
→ Customer writes their order in the group (free text, handwritten note photo, or voice note)
→ AI listener reads it, maps items to your product/SKU catalog
→ Structured order created automatically on ZoTok
→ Your team reviews, edits if needed (price, quantity), and accepts
→ Order confirmation sent back to the customer in the group

Your team stops manually re-entering orders from WhatsApp groups into the system.

New Lead Management — Facebook/Instagram/Website to WhatsApp
Leads from Facebook, Instagram, and your website land on your official WABA number via Click-to-WhatsApp → AI qualifies the lead (product interest, inquiry type, contact details, urgency) → structured lead profile created in ZoTok → your sales team sees a prioritised call list with full conversation context.

For document-heavy inquiries: brochures, specifications, and quotations can be sent via WABA within the 24-hour conversation window. All documents tracked in the ZoTok dashboard.

AI is trained on your knowledge bank (product documents, FAQs, pricing structure) — first-level queries answered automatically. Complex queries escalated to your team.

ZoGrow Digital Expert
If you'd like your campaigns managed end-to-end: our digital expert sets up Facebook/Instagram campaigns with WhatsApp CTAs, creates ad creatives (with your approval), runs A/B testing, manages lead funnels, and sends weekly performance reports. Following up on our previous discussion and the commercial proposal shared earlier, I'm also sharing a few WhatsApp screens showcasing the retailer ordering journey for your reference.
The screens demonstrate how retailers can directly interact with your WhatsApp catalogue, browse products, view relevant product information, and place orders digitally without having to depend entirely on the salesperson for every order.
We believe this can add significant value to your current sales process in a few key areas:
- Reduce salesperson dependency – Retailers can browse the catalogue and initiate orders directly on WhatsApp, reducing the effort required from the sales team for routine orders.

- 24×7 ordering convenience – Retailers can browse products and place orders at their convenience, even outside the salesperson's regular visit or calling cycle.
- Better product and scheme visibility – Retailers can have a structured view of available products, pricing and applicable schemes instead of relying on scattered communication.
- Faster order processing – Once the order is captured digitally, it can move into the downstream order-processing workflow with minimal manual intervention.
- Better visibility for the business – Your team gets a clearer view of retailer interactions, orders and product demand across the network.
The broader objective is not to replace the salesperson, but to reduce repetitive transactional work and allow the sales team to spend more time on retailer relationships, market development and higher-value activities.
I believe the WhatsApp ordering journey we have shared can complement the proposed solution and create a more efficient digital ordering experience for your retailer network.

emails.body:
Hi Hepil Doshi ji,

Thank you for the time on Friday, and for the thoughtful questions — especially around adoption and how this lands with your sales team internally. That's exactly the kind of thinking that makes a rollout actually work.

Here's a quick recap of what we covered:

- Live walkthrough of our in-progress Vadilal project — AI parsing handwritten, multilingual POD notes, matching them against invoices, and flagging shortages or damage automatically
- Handwritten order digitization: tested against 5,000+ samples, currently at 85-90% accuracy across regional handwriting and product synonym variations (similar to what we've built for ITC Classmate)
- India Gate's lightweight example — a WhatsApp number salesmen can query directly for their own KPI performance, pulled from an existing Google Sheet

Pain points and workflows we discussed, which we'll carry into the journey document for your review:

Salesperson absenteeism / smart basket — on days a beat is missed, retailers in that area get a WhatsApp nudge with a predictive suggested order based on past ordering patterns, which they can edit and confirm directly; some accounts have seen 17-18% incremental revenue recovered from otherwise-missed beats

Dormant / bottom-pyramid retailer activation — engaging retailers who are costly to visit in person (small ticket sizes, low frequency) through WhatsApp-based ordering, schemes, and offers instead

Handwritten and voice-note order structuring — converting free-text, voice notes, or handwritten orders into structured, SKU-mapped orders that get routed to the correct distributor for acceptance and edits

POD / delivery-proof digitization — as shown live for Wadi Lal: parsing handwritten, multilingual delivery notes, matching them to invoices, and flagging shortages or damage automatically instead of waiting on physical paperwork

AI group listener for leadership visibility — a number added to relevant WhatsApp groups (operations, sales, dispatch) that surfaces signals like price negotiation, invoice requests, or delivery complaints without requiring anyone to manually monitor every group

Salesperson WhatsApp-based operations — attendance/check-in, beat planning, order capture, and new retailer onboarding, all without requiring the sales team to leave WhatsApp or adopt a separate app

On the adoption question you raised: as Girish mentioned, companies like Adani Wilmar and Haldiram have found it works best when WhatsApp ordering is set as an explicit target for the sales team rather than left as an optional channel — happy to go deeper on how that's been structured for other accounts if useful.

ZoToK Enterprise Deck

Next steps:

1. We'll send over detailed journey/wireframe visualizations built around the specific problem statements above, so you have something concrete to evaluate and share internally
2. On your end, it would help to validate internally and identify 2-3 use cases that feel like the right low-effort starting point
3. As Girish noted, we'd recommend a lightweight pilot approach (SFTP/Excel-based exchange rather than deep SAP integration) to get moving quickly and iterate from there

Please let us know if anything comes up as you think this through internally — happy to jump on a call anytime.

Thank you again for your time.

Regards,
Anshul Shrivastav
VP – Sales & BD

Dear Edwin,

Thank you for the time today. As promised, here is a summary of the four points we addressed, and the one action we need from you to move to the commercial.

API Integration — No Manual Updates Required
All data (customer master, product master, ledger, invoices, outstanding) will be synced between CHS's AutoCount ERP and ZoTok via API integration. No manual file uploads, no manual data entry from your team after go-live. ZoTok's API team will require 1–2 calls with CHS's technical team to map the API fields — your team provides the API support.

Chinese Handwriting + Multilingual OCR — Accuracy Timeline
At the start of deployment, OCR accuracy on Chinese handwritten orders will be 80–85%. Within 45–60 days of go-live, it will reach 90–95%. Here's how:
→ Items AI cannot read confidently are flagged as "unmapped"
→ Your team or ZoTok's team manually maps that SKU once
→ AI learns automatically — the same handwriting style maps correctly from that point forward
→ If a customer sends an illegible scribble with a quantity, AI asks clarifying questions ("Are you ordering from Division A or B? Is this Product X?") until the SKU is confirmed

This self-learning model means the system gets more accurate with every order placed, continuously.

Phase-by-Milestone Commercial Structure
Commercial obligations are tied to phase delivery — not to the start date. You will not be billed until each phase is delivered and verified. Once a phase milestone is achieved, the corresponding commercial tranche becomes due.

Scope Confirmation Process
You confirmed you have reviewed the scope document in detail. As the next step, we need your written confirmation that the scope as submitted is agreed (email confirmation is sufficient). Once we receive that, we will release the milestone-wise commercial proposal in our next email.

emails.body:
Hi Sheetal,

Thank you for the detailed questions. We've mapped each of your queries to a clear answer below, so your team has one reference point for how setup, integration, and ongoing ownership will work.

- Who will own the technical setup and integrations? For example, WABA, WhatsApp number onboarding, access configuration, social accounts, Google Sheets/data integration, etc. Will your team handle the complete setup, or will something need to be done from your side?
Answer: The complete setup and implementation will be owned end-to-end by the ZoTok implementation team, as per the scope document submitted. Your team will not need to manage any of this independently.

- SDK/API and integration: What APIs, webhooks, SDKs, or integration options will be available for us if we need to integrate ZoTok with our existing systems/CRM in the future?
Answer: For pre-integrated ERP/CRM systems such as Tally, Zoho Books, or SAP B1, our team can handle the integration directly. For any custom integration requirement, we'll first define the scope in a separate document. We also offer open APIs that can be shared with your technical team, along with integration support from our side. Where custom integration code needs to be written by us, we'll share the associated timeline and cost separately.

- Internal WhatsApp group intelligence: How exactly will the groups be connected, and what permissions/access will be required? This is an important area from a privacy and security perspective.
Answer: ZoTok uses a single dedicated mobile number from your side, which is configured as an AI Listener. This number is added by your group admin to the relevant business WhatsApp groups — i.e., only the groups your leadership/access-role team members choose to include. Since the number is added directly by your admin with full visibility into which groups it joins, there's no privacy or security gap on our end.

- AI training and ownership: How will the CoEvolve product/knowledge data be provided, updated, and maintained? Also, who will be responsible for correcting or updating the AI if it provides incorrect information?
Answer: AI training and knowledge bank setup are included in our scope. The underlying product/knowledge content will need to be provided by your team. Ongoing updates and corrections to the AI's knowledge base will be managed by our dedicated digital expert, who is assigned to your account as part of the services scope.

- Campaign dependency: The scope appears to include ongoing campaign execution and weekly optimisation. I would like to understand how much of this will depend on your team versus our internal team, especially if we want to make changes ourselves later.
Answer: Campaign execution, creative management, and performance tracking/optimization for each campaign will be handled by our digital expert, delivered as part of the ZoGrow module outlined in the scope and commercial document.

We are happy to proceed with the payment milestones as outlined below:
- 50% Initial Payment (Advance): Upon project confirmation and commencement.
- 50% Balance Payment: Upon completion of full setup and successful User Acceptance Testing (UAT sign-off).
Once we receive the Purchase Order (PO) from your end, we will immediately generate and share the Proforma Invoice to initiate the initial payment process.
Looking forward to kicking off the project!

Regards,
Anshul Shrivastav
VP – Sales & BD
ZoToK | ZONO Tradetech Private Limited

Dear Daman chandra Ji,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with us today. It was great understanding your pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution business, and how your B2B ordering currently flows through your sales team, WhatsApp, and Marg ERP.

As discussed, here is a quick recap of how ZoTok can help:

1. Structured WhatsApp Ordering for Retailers
Today, a lot of order and quotation communication happens over personal WhatsApp chats with no central record. ZoTok brings this onto your official WhatsApp number with an intelligent catalog - your retailers can view products, check ledger balance, select quantities, and receive an order estimate, all natively within WhatsApp.

2. Order Capture from Any Format
We understood that many of your retailers still write orders on paper and share a photo over WhatsApp. ZoTok can read these images (and text-based orders) and convert them into structured orders, which are then pushed directly into your Marg ERP - removing manual re-entry for your team.

3. Sales Team Order Consolidation
For orders your salespeople collect from retailers via calls or WhatsApp groups, ZoTok provides a simple order summary flow - your salesperson enters or accepts the order, submits it, and it flows into the ZoTok order section for bulk upload to Marg, cutting down manual Excel work.

4. Marg ERP Integration (Communication Layer Only)
As clarified on the call, ZoTok does not generate invoices or replace Marg - it sits purely as a communication layer, capturing orders on WhatsApp and syncing them to Marg via our SFTP integration, after which invoices are shared back with your retailers over WhatsApp.

5. Customer Re-engagement & Campaigns
For retailers who haven't ordered in a while (e.g. the last two months), ZoTok can send personalized nudges and campaign messages directly to their WhatsApp number, helping you revive dormant accounts and drive fresh activity.

ZoTok for Dr. Smith — how it fits your process

As Ashish ji requested — in your own workflow, not a generic pitch.

Retailer order collection → distributor mapping → Order Edits / Approval confirmation

Your salesperson visits a retailer, collects their order (handwritten note, voice note, or WhatsApp message) → ZoTok AI reads it and maps each line item to Dr. Smith’s SKU master (using the lingo and short codes your retailers actually write, not just OCR) → draft order created with the retailer’s correct price (segmented by customer/distributor margin, from Tally) → sent for ASM/SM approval via the ZoTok PWA → once approved, order confirmed to retailer with the final quote → distributor receives the order for fulfilment → retailer can confirm, modify, or ask questions before the order is locked.

For retailers who prefer to order themselves: the same flow works via WhatsApp self-service — they browse the catalog, place an order, and the same approval and fulfilment process runs.

Salesperson field ops — beat plan, attendance, order capture, performance tracking

Area manager sets up weekly/monthly beat plans in the ZoTok backend → salesperson types “Zoe my plan” each morning on WhatsApp → list of retailers to visit, with location → check-in at each retailer location (time and GPS stamped) → order captured on behalf of the retailer → day closure report sent automatically to the area manager.

Performance reports: per salesperson, per day/month — orders collected, value, locations visited, targets vs. achievement. Downloadable from ZoTok dashboard. Can also be pushed to Google Sheets for custom reporting in whatever format your management uses.

Retailer secondary bill collection + scheme validation

Retailer photographs their purchase invoice from the distributor → sends to Dr. Smith’s WhatsApp number → ZoTok validates: which line items are Dr. Smith products? Which are eligible for the scheme? Is this a duplicate invoice? Is it authentic? → eligible scheme value calculated → retailer gets instant confirmation: “Your invoice of ₹X has been validated. Eligible value: ₹Y. Your next reward milestone: ₹Z.”

Dr. Smith gets a dashboard: how many retailers participated, total secondary turnover, scheme payouts due.

Payment collection — outstanding reminders from Tally

For distributors with outstanding → automated WhatsApp payment reminders based on invoice age and outstanding amount — segmented (e.g., overdue > 30 days, > ₹50,000) → distributor responds with promise-to-pay date → auto-tracked. Your accounts team stops making 50 calls a day.

• Internal WhatsApp nudges for approval team: notifications for pending order approvals go via PWA (not WhatsApp) — Ashish ji confirmed this is fine.
• Salesforce integration: to be discussed once Salesforce is live; Tally integration is the starting point.

No additional licenses required: ZoTok’s subscription includes all AI (LLM, agentic flows, OCR+AI mapping). No ChatGPT, Google AI licenses needed from your side.

Saumya Ji — whenever you’ve had a chance to share the recording and journey with the management team, please do loop us in for a session with them. We’re happy to present again with Dr. Smith’s product and process as the demo context.

Ashishji, please do share Dr. Smith’s product catalog whenever convenient — we’ll build a clickable journey using your products so management can see exactly how their process would look on ZoTok.

Dear Adesh and Arihant,

Thank you both for your time today and for the insightful questions. The discussion was extremely helpful in understanding Ecoflex's requirements and how we can best align our solution with your ordering and customer management processes.

As a quick recap of our discussion:
1. Single WhatsApp Number (WABA): One AI-powered WhatsApp number can manage all your existing order workflows, eliminating the need for multiple numbers.
2. Order Capture: Orders received via text, handwritten documents, or digital catalogs are automatically structured and pushed into Tally.
3. Tally Integration: ZoTok is not a system of record. Customer and product master data remain in Tally, with ZoTok syncing through customer IDs, ensuring no data duplication. A standard Tally license is sufficient; no additional licensing is required.
4. Customer-Specific Pricing: Even if customer-wise pricing is not maintained in Tally, customized price lists can be managed directly within ZoTok.
5. Price Updates: Pricing can be updated quickly through bulk Excel uploads, which is especially useful for frequent polymer price changes. Updates can also be handled by your dedicated account manager upon request.
6. Document & Order Tracking: All quotations and orders remain accessible within the WhatsApp conversation history and are also securely stored in the ZoTok backend for download and reference.
7. Integration Flexibility: We support both open APIs for custom integrations and lightweight SFTP/folder-based integrations where API connectivity is not required.
8. Automated Payment Workflows: Automated payment reminders, promise-to-pay nudges, early-payment incentive messages, and payment receipt confirmations can all be triggered based on Tally updates.

emails.body:
Dear Piyush Ji,

Thank you for a wonderful conversation today — and for the frankness throughout. It was a pleasure to connect, especially knowing we share a bond through Heartfulness and through Vishal Kothari Ji. Small world indeed.

As promised, here is the detailed scope document and full commercial breakdown — no hidden charges, exactly as you asked.

Scope for Kanha Natural Oils — Phase 1

Exhibition & Trade Show Lead Capture — Your Most Immediate Problem

You collected visiting cards at Pragati Maidan. Nobody followed up in time. The conversation context was lost.

With ZoTok:

Visitor scans a QR code at your stall (or you photograph their visiting card and share it in a WhatsApp group with @Zoe) → ZoTok automatically extracts the contact details → a welcome message goes to the visitor's WhatsApp instantly: "Thank you for visiting Kanha Natural Oils. We deal in [product categories]. What were you looking for today?" → AI handles their response in their language → conversation profiled as hot/warm/cold based on what they say → you get a prioritised list of who to call first.

No lead goes cold. No context is lost. Even if you're still at the stall talking to someone else, ZoTok has already engaged the visitor who just walked away.

B2B Inquiry Management — Domestic & International

You have ~1,000 international contacts and a domestic database. Right now, when someone sends an inquiry — domestic or international — you have to respond manually, often late.

ZoTok adds an AI layer:
→ Customer messages your official WABA number (any language — English, Hindi, Arabic, etc.)
→ AI asks the right qualification questions: which oil, which quality grade (your rose oil has multiple), what quantity, what end use, which country
→ Customer is profiled and their inquiry is structured
→ You get a summary: "New B2B inquiry from Germany. Product: Rose Oil. Quantity: 50 kg. Grade: Premium. They're a fragrance house."
→ You call them with full context. No wasted time.

For Facebook/Instagram campaigns (India or international geography-targeted): customer sees your ad → clicks "Chat on WhatsApp" → AI begins the qualification conversation automatically.

AI Knowledge Bank — Complex SKU Pricing Without Exposing a Rate Card

Your rose oil has multiple price points — 100ml, 500ml, 1kg, 10kg, 1 lakh ml — each with quality tiers. You cannot show a static price list on WhatsApp.

ZoTok trains an AI on your product master — your "personal ChatGPT". When a customer asks about rose oil pricing, AI asks: which quality grade? what quantity? what end use? Based on their answers, AI either quotes the right range or flags it to you for a manual quote. Customer never sees a static rate card. AI never gives a wrong price — it qualifies first, then responds.

Why ZoTok vs. the other 3 vendors you're comparing

Two questions to ask every vendor:
→ Is the conversation two-way with AI? Or does a human team have to respond to every inquiry?
→ Does the loop close — inquiry → AI qualification → profiled lead → your follow-up with full context? Or does the inquiry just land in a dashboard for you to figure out?

ZoTok answers yes to both. Others will give you grey answers.

ZoTok Enterprise Deck

Piyush Ji, you're a single person managing everything — your product, your customers, your exhibitions, your follow-ups. ZoTok's job is to make sure no lead goes cold while you're busy making the product. That's the promise.

Happy to connect again whenever you're ready. Take your time comparing — and if there's any question on the commercial or scope, just call.

Regards,
Anshul Shrivastav
VP – Sales & BD
ZoToK | ZONO Tradetech Private Limited

Hello Mangeysh Sir,

Thank you for the time on Tuesday — for the very sharp questions throughout. Really appreciated the depth of the evaluation.

Clickable product journey (self-navigate): FMCG Journey (https://main.d316ym2oexcryf.amplifyapp.com/projects/Haldirams/index.html)

ZoTok for Maganlal — how it fits your process

New Retailer Onboarding via Facebook/Instagram → WhatsApp
Running Meta ads but have no WhatsApp conversion mechanism. Every ad click that doesn’t convert is a lost lead. ZoTok adds a Click-to-WhatsApp CTA:
Retailer clicks the ad → lands on Maganlal’s official WhatsApp → AI qualifies (what do you sell, where are you, what do you carry) → KYC collected (GST, location, business details) → lead profiled and routed to the right salesperson for approval → once approved, they’re onboarded and get a self-service menu for ordering, schemes, and product queries.

Retailer order collection → distributor mapping → Order Edits / Approval confirmation
Your salesperson visits a retailer, collects their order (handwritten note, voice note, or WhatsApp message) → ZoTok AI reads it and maps each line item to Dr. Smith’s SKU master (using the lingo and short codes your retailers actually write, not just OCR) → draft order created with the retailer’s correct price (segmented by customer/distributor margin, from Tally) → sent for ASM/SM approval via the ZoTok PWA → once approved, order confirmed to retailer with the final quote → distributor receives the order for fulfilment → retailer can confirm, modify, or ask questions before the order is locked.
For retailers who prefer to order themselves: the same flow works via WhatsApp self-service — they browse the catalog, place an order, and the same approval and fulfilment process runs.

Salesperson field ops — beat plan, attendance, order capture, performance tracking
Area manager sets up weekly/monthly beat plans in the ZoTok backend → salesperson types “Zoe my plan” each morning on WhatsApp → list of retailers to visit, with location → check-in at each retailer location (time and GPS stamped) → order captured on behalf of the retailer → day closure report sent automatically to the area manager.
Performance reports: per salesperson, per day/month — orders collected, value, locations visited, targets vs. achievement. Downloadable from ZoTok dashboard. Can also be pushed to Google Sheets for custom reporting in whatever format your management uses.

Retailer secondary bill collection + scheme validation
Retailer photographs their purchase invoice from the distributor → sends to Dr. Smith’s WhatsApp number → ZoTok validates: which line items are Dr. Smith products? Which are eligible for the scheme? Is this a duplicate invoice? Is it authentic? → eligible scheme value calculated → retailer gets instant confirmation: “Your invoice of ₹X has been validated. Eligible value: ₹Y. Your next reward milestone: ₹Z.”
Maganlal gets a dashboard: how many retailers participated, total secondary turnover, scheme payouts due.

Payment collection — outstanding reminders from Tally
For distributors with outstanding → automated WhatsApp payment reminders based on invoice age and outstanding amount — segmented (e.g., overdue > 30 days, > ₹50,000) → distributor responds with promise-to-pay date → auto-tracked. Your accounts team stops making 50 calls a day.

Suggested next step
We’ll build a clickable journey using your products so you can see exactly how your process would look on ZoTok. Let's meet next week to allow us to showcase the journey and collect your feedback.

Thank you again for the time to allow us showcase our product offering.

Regards,

emails.body:
Hi CK Sharma Ji & Sudhakar ji,

Thank you for the time on Saturday, and for being direct about where things stand — it helps us build something that's actually useful rather than overlapping with what you already have.

Here's a quick recap:

- You currently run SAP, along with an existing DMS, SFA, and Interact for retailer WhatsApp communication
- The gap we identified together: Interact operates as a one-way broadcast tool, while ZoTok's agentic AI enables genuine two-way conversations — retailers can respond, place orders, upload invoices, and get real answers, not just receive messages
- We landed on three use cases sufficient for a pilot: retailer engagement, order booking (mapped directly to the correct distributor), and invoice-based interaction
- You'd prefer a lightweight SFTP-based integration over deeper API integration to start, which keeps things simple on your DMS side
- Karnataka as the proposed pilot market, with retailer counts to follow once scope is finalized

We also walked through a few relevant workflows from similar FMCG rollouts that we'll build into the scope document for your review:

Invoice upload with reward validation — retailer photographs and sends an invoice, AI validates format, line items, and distributor mapping within seconds, flags any mismatches, and pushes qualifying retailers toward milestone-based rewards (Not part of Pilot Scope)

Smart basket for uncovered beats — on days a salesperson can't cover a scheduled beat, retailers in that beat get a WhatsApp nudge with a predictive order suggestion; this drove meaningful conversion in accounts where no orders were otherwise happening (Not part of Pilot Scope)

Retailer self-onboarding on WhatsApp — new retailer fills details, GST/KYC verification happens conversationally, and once approved they're auto-mapped to the right salesperson/distributor with a self-service ordering menu

Retailer order booking & mapping to distributor — structured orders (from free text, voice notes, or handwritten notes) get parsed, matched to SKUs, and routed to the correct distributor for acceptance/edits on WhatsApp itself

Retailer Engagement , Push campaigns with milestone tracking — targeted nudges (e.g., scheme reminders) with tracking visibility into delivery, views, and engagement & orders so your team can see actual ROI rather than a shoot-and-hope broadcast

We'll structure the scope document around these workflows mapped to your three chosen use cases, plus:

1. Scope document covering the pilot solution, testing-phase plan for Karnataka specifically

We understand budget discipline is front of mind, and we'll keep the pilot commercials tightly scoped rather than positioning this as a parallel cost alongside your existing tools.

We'll have both documents to you by Tuesday, and propose connecting Wednesday or Thursday to walk through them together. Please loop in anyone else from your team who should be part of that conversation.

Looking forward to it.

Regards,
Anshul Shrivastav

emails.subject: Organic Tattva <> ZoTok | AI-Powered WhatsApp Conversational Platform
emails.body:
Dear Abhinav Ji,

Thank you for a very grounded and strategic conversation today. The clarity with which you described Organic Tattva's channel architecture — super stockists, sub-distributors, retailers, and your growth targets — gave us exactly the right context to design the trial.

As discussed, here is the summary and proposed trial structure.

Three use cases mapped to your channel

P2 — Super Stockist → Sub-Distributor: Order Automation + Invoice + Payment on WhatsApp

Your sub-distributors are currently placing orders with super stockists on WhatsApp informally.

ZoTok structures this:

Sub-distributor sends order on WhatsApp (free text, voice note, or handwritten photo) → AI maps to Organic Tattva SKU master → super stockist receives structured order notification → accepts or edits → order pushed to super stockist's system → invoice generated → automatically sent to sub-distributor on WhatsApp → payment reminder sent as per credit cycle. (Integration Scope to be discussed)

Your sub-distributors don't need to learn anything new. They continue on WhatsApp. ZoTok is just the structured communication layer between them.

P3 — Sales Team + Sub-Distributors → Retailers: Scheme Communication + Order Capture + Absenteeism Coverage

Your 160 salespeople currently collect retailer orders on WhatsApp and share with sub-distributors. ZoTok automates this:

→ Retailer asks about scheme, price, product availability on WhatsApp → AI answers instantly from Organic Tattva's knowledge bank — no salesperson needed for L1 queries
→ Retailer places order (free text / voice / handwritten photo) → AI structures it → sub-distributor notified → retailer gets confirmation
→ When a salesperson is absent: retailers on that beat get an automatic WhatsApp nudge with their smart basket (based on past order history) — Adani Wilmar (Fortune Oil) uses this exact model; 8–12% conversion on absenteeism-triggered orders in the first quarter

New Sub-D & Retailer Onboarding via Facebook/Instagram → WhatsApp

You're already running Meta ads but have no WhatsApp conversion mechanism. Every ad click that doesn't convert is a lost lead. ZoTok adds a Click-to-WhatsApp CTA:

Retailer or sub-distributor clicks the ad → lands on Organic Tattva's official WhatsApp → AI qualifies (what do you sell, where are you, what do you carry) → KYC collected (GST, location, business details) → lead profiled and routed to the right salesperson for approval → once approved, they're onboarded and get a self-service menu for ordering, schemes, and product queries.

For your target of 700 sub-distributors by September and 18,000+ retailers by year end — this is the fastest onboarding mechanism without adding salespeople.

Proposed trial structure (as Vishal discussed at close)

→ 1–2 geographies (you nominate — preferably states where you have active super stockists and sub-distributors already on WhatsApp)
→ A dozen sub-distributors to start (trial at P2 level first, then extend to P3)
→ 3 problem statements in sequence: (1) sub-D ordering + invoice on WhatsApp, (2) scheme communication + retailer queries, (3) Facebook/Instagram CTWA for new retailer onboarding
→ Learn from the pilot, fix SKU mapping and flow — then scale pan-India with the same playbook

For the trial to begin, we need two things from you:
1. Which 1–2 states would you like to start with?
2. Names/contacts of 2–3 super stockists in those states who will anchor the pilot

Once you share these, we'll design the Organic Tattva-specific workflow and commercial proposal within the week. In couple of days, I will share the workflow journey for Organic Tattva for your review.

ZoTok Enterprise Deck: https://canva.link/ewagfba6cn3lwjt

Thank you again, Abhinav Ji. Looking forward to getting started.

Regards,
Anshul Shrivastav
VP – Sales & BD

emails.subject: Thank You – ZoTok x Pacific Switchgear Asia18 | Discussion Recap & Phase-wise Approach
emails.body:
Dear Mr. Solanki,
Thank you for taking the time to connect with us. It was great understanding your current operations and discussing how ZoTok can support Pacific Switchgear Asia18 in automating your order-to-cash journey on WhatsApp.
As discussed, here is a quick recap of your current process and how we see ZoTok fitting in:

Your current process
- Inquiries come in via phone calls, WhatsApp, and email (including handwritten/photo-based inquiries)
- Quotations are prepared manually in Tally, with multiple price lists and discount slabs maintained per customer
- Some key institutional/OEM accounts require quotations strictly over email
- Payment follow-ups are currently manual, handled by your accounts team

How ZoTok can help
- Demand Capture: Convert inquiries from WhatsApp, WhatsApp groups, and paper/photo formats into structured quotations instantly using our AI agent
- Tally Integration: Quotations automatically map to your existing price lists and discount structures, and push directly as sales orders into Tally
- Demand Fulfillment: Automate dispatch updates, ledger sharing, invoices, and payment reminders on WhatsApp, reducing dependency on manual follow-ups by your accounts team
- Demand Generation: Re-engage dormant customers and capture new leads from channels like Meta (Facebook/Instagram), IndiaMART, and your website, routing them into WhatsApp
- Dedicated Account Manager: A single point of contact whose focus is your account's success and adoption, not upselling

Phase-wise approach discussed
- Phase 1 (Immediate rollout, 2–4 weeks): Onboard customers already active on WhatsApp — automated quotation generation, order creation, Tally sales order push (with existing price lists/discounts), and WhatsApp-based payment reminders. Week 1 focuses on workflow setup and team training; weeks 2–4 scale this to your active customer base.
- Phase 2 (~4–6 weeks out): Email integration, to bring your OEM/institutional accounts (who require quotations over email) onto the same automated workflow.
- Phase 3 (Post 3 months): Voice/IVR-based automation for calls and payment reminders, once this module completes testing and is officially launched — we'll bring this to you as soon as it's ready.

This phased rollout lets us start automating for the ~50% of your customers already on WhatsApp right away, while we build towards full coverage across email and voice.

For your reference:
- Enterprise Deck
- Demo Video: https://youtu.be/VAKfk2lcAcI
- Case Studies: https://www.zotok.ai/casestudies

Commercials: ZOTOK_ Pacific Switchgear.pdf

Next steps: As discussed with Nisheeth, we're happy to set up an in-person meeting with our on-ground team in Pune, or with our VP of Sales, whenever convenient for you.

Thank you once again for your time and for sharing such detailed context on your operations — it really helps us tailor the solution to your business.
Looking forward to working together.

Bhagyasree Kotamraju

ZONO Tradetech Private Limited

Instantly respond to dealer and customer enquiries on WhatsApp, including WhatsApp group-based communication, using automated workflows. This reduces manual follow-ups and ensures faster responses to customers and distributors.

A 24x7 AI assistant that automatically shares product details and pricing, answers dealer or customer queries, and captures B2B order requirements directly on WhatsApp.

Distributors and retailers can place primary and secondary orders directly through WhatsApp using simple text or images. ZoTok's AI engine can recognize order messages and help your team create and process orders quickly from the dashboard.

- New product launches

Automatically capture orders from WhatsApp groups in any format (text, images, voice notes, or Excel) and convert them into structured orders. Get real-time estimates, instant order confirmations, and a centralized view of all group conversations while reducing manual effort.

emails.subject: Streamlining Order Management & Customer Engagement for SH Food Products
emails.body:
Dear Tarun Ji,

Thank you for taking the time to attend the product walkthrough. It was great speaking with you and understanding the current processes at SH Food Products.

As discussed during the meeting, ZoTok can help streamline your dealer communication, order management, and customer engagement through WhatsApp while reducing manual effort for your team.

How ZoTok Will Help

1. Automated Dealer & Customer Handling
Instantly respond to dealer and customer enquiries on WhatsApp, including WhatsApp group-based communication, using automated workflows. This reduces manual follow-ups and ensures faster responses to customers and distributors.

2. GenAI WhatsApp Knowledge Bot
A 24×7 AI assistant that automatically shares product details and pricing, answers dealer or customer queries, and captures B2B order requirements directly on WhatsApp.

3. WhatsApp-Based Order Capture
Distributors and retailers can place primary and secondary orders directly through WhatsApp using simple text or images. ZoTok's AI engine can recognize order messages and help your team create and process orders quickly from the dashboard.

4. Customer Segmentation & Marketing
Segment your customers based on activity such as Active vs. Dormant dealers.
This helps you send targeted messages like:
- New product launches
- Special offers
- Payment reminders for pending balances

5. WhatsApp Group Order & Query Management
Automatically capture orders from WhatsApp groups in any format (text, images, voice notes, or Excel) and convert them into structured orders. Get real-time estimates, instant order confirmations, and a centralized view of all group conversations while reducing manual effort.

1. It is stated in the previously shared document states '2000 users'; what does it mean? Does this mean only 2,000 numbers will be able to use the WABA number for purchasing, or is it the number on which we will be able to campaign?

Answer: The 2,000 MAC (Monthly Active Customers) mentioned in the document represents the indicative upper limit of unique customers who are expected to actively engage with the ZoToK WhatsApp solution in a month.

This is primarily considered as a fair-usage benchmark and does not mean that only 2,000 customer numbers can use the WABA number for purchasing or that campaigns can be sent only to 2,000 customers.

For example, if the number of unique active customer conversations increases to 2,300 in a particular month, there will be no additional subscription charge for that month. However, if there is a consistent increase in Monthly Active Customers over 2–3 consecutive months, we would discuss the increased usage with Shree NM Electricals and, if required, move to the appropriate higher MAC slab.

You can initiate campaigns to your entire customer database, and there is no restriction from ZoToK's offering on the number of customers you can target for campaigns.

2. How will the pricing increase with the number of users?

Answer: The pricing is linked to the Monthly Active Customer (MAC) slab rather than a one-time increase based on the number of customers using the platform.

If there is a sustained increase in the number of unique customers actively engaging with the ZoToK solution every month, Shree NM Electricals may move to the next applicable MAC slab.

For example, the next slab could be 3,000 MAC, with an incremental cost of approximately ₹30 per additional MAC over the existing slab.

The higher slab would be discussed and mutually agreed upon based on the sustained usage pattern, rather than being triggered by a temporary increase in usage in any single month.

emails.body:
Hi Satya,

Thanks for flagging these — good questions, and important to close out before we proceed ahead,

Responding to both below.

1. When visiting "Order Now," I see the following URL in the browser: mobile.zotok.ai is it a fixed case, or in our implement we can use own domain's URL ? I need clarity on this.

Answer: mobile.zotok.ai is our default hosted domain for the WhatsApp ordering/catalog webview, used across client implementations out of the box. To complete the loop of commerce and conversation, our architecture is designed so that the digital catalog view — with all modules like segmented pricing, pack sizes, and other details — is maintained while showcasing the catalog on our domain. This also lets us trigger nudges if there's a drop-off before an order is placed, to re-engage the customer and encourage them to complete the purchase.

Technically, it is possible — with some custom development, we'd be able to get your own domain listed instead. That said, none of our clients have opted for this so far, simply because redirecting to your domain breaks the loop between conversation and commerce, which is central to how the experience is designed to work and also, it's not that easily visible. If you'd still like to pursue this, it would take approximately 10–12 weeks to implement.

2. Also I found that the AI bot replies to general conversation, albeit in a very controlled way. Please highlight any potential issues.

Answer: You're right that the bot is designed to handle general/off-catalog conversation in a controlled, guarded manner rather than shutting down completely — this is intentional, so the experience doesn't feel robotic when a user types something outside a strict order flow (greetings, small talk, vague queries, etc.).

A few things worth being aware of with this design, so we can jointly decide how tightly to scope it for your rollout:
- If guardrails are too loose, the bot could stray into giving pricing, delivery, or commitment-like responses that aren't backed by your actual catalog/ERP data — this needs to stay strictly fenced off.
- Escalation/handoff: for anything genuinely outside its trained scope, there should be a clear fallback to a human agent rather than the bot attempting an answer.
- General responses should stay aligned with Shree NM Electricals', not read as generic or off-brand.

We actively monitor and tune these guardrails, and that'll also let us tighten it further based on how your customers actually interact with it.

Regards,
Anshul Shrivastav
VP – Sales & BD
ZoToK | ZONO Tradetech Private Limited

Dear Mr. Srinivas, Mr. Manish, and Team,

Thank you for taking the time to connect with us today and for providing a comprehensive overview of your aftermarket business operations, ongoing digital initiatives, and future objectives. We sincerely appreciate the opportunity to engage with your team and gain a deeper understanding of the current processes, challenges, and priorities within Shriram Pistons & Rings Ltd.'s aftermarket ecosystem.

- Channel Adoption: While digital platforms and portals are being introduced, a significant portion of channel interactions continue to occur through WhatsApp, emails, and manual processes, creating adoption challenges across distributors and retailers.
- Order Management Efficiency: Primary order collection continues to involve manual intervention through emails, paper-based processes, and sales personnel.
- Distributor and Retailer Engagement: With a large distributor ecosystem, ensuring consistent communication, product awareness, scheme visibility, and timely engagement remains an important business priority.
- Product Information Accessibility: Dealers, mechanics, and workshops often seek product information using practical or regional terminology, making it challenging to quickly access relevant technical and catalog information.
- Customer Service and Complaint Resolution: Managing warranty claims, shortage complaints, transit damages, service requests, and customer queries through a structured and trackable process is a key area of interest.
- Business Visibility and Insights: Valuable customer interactions, demand signals, and operational issues frequently remain scattered across WhatsApp groups and communication channels.
- Technology Integration and Governance: Any future solution evaluation would need alignment with your IT and Digital teams to assess integration requirements, data security, privacy, SAP connectivity, and deployment architecture.

- AI-powered product and knowledge assistance through WhatsApp.

Hope you're doing well.
I wanted to follow up on our earlier discussion and take the conversation one step further. Since we had already shared the customized ZöTok journey and sample screens, I thought it would be useful to highlight how these workflows can translate into tangible business value for your team.
Situation
A significant part of dealer and sales-team communication already happens on WhatsApp — orders, product enquiries, pricing, schemes, payment follow-ups and day-to-day coordination. The challenge is that these conversations often remain unstructured and disconnected from the core business systems, creating manual dependency and limited visibility.
Task
The opportunity with ZöTok is not to introduce another app or change the way your dealers work. Instead, the objective is to make the existing WhatsApp communication actionable — converting conversations into structured orders, insights, follow-ups and business actions.
Action – Where ZöTok Can Add Value
1. Dealer Ordering & Order Automation
Dealers can browse products, check applicable pricing/schemes and place orders directly through WhatsApp. AI can also process text, images, handwritten orders and other unstructured formats, converting them into structured orders for further processing.
2. Sales & Performance Visibility
The management team can get visibility into order trends, revenue, active customers, top-selling products and overall sales performance — helping identify where the business is growing and where intervention is required.
3. Distributor & Dealer Engagement
Targeted WhatsApp campaigns can be used for new product launches, schemes, offers, reactivation and upsell/cross-sell opportunities, with the ability to segment customers and track campaign effectiveness.

6. Team & Operational Coordination
Instead of multiple disconnected WhatsApp conversations, customer communication and internal coordination can be structured around the relevant teams, enabling sales, finance and fulfilment teams to work with better context and visibility.
Result
The larger objective is to help your team achieve:
• Faster and more structured order processing
• Higher dealer engagement and ordering adoption
• Reduced manual dependency on sales/back-office teams
• Better visibility into sales, orders and customer activity
• Improved payment and outstanding follow-ups
• More effective scheme, campaign and reactivation execution
• A single conversational layer connecting Dealers → Sales Team → Distributor → Finance → ERP

emails.body:
Dear Mr. Kaushik,

Thank you for taking the time to discuss your business requirements and explore how ZoTok can support Volos Energy's growth initiatives. It was great learning about your business model as a distributor of solar modules across Gujarat and your plans to expand pan-India.

As discussed, ZoTok is a WhatsApp-based conversational commerce platform that can help streamline customer engagement, lead management, marketing campaigns, and order-to-cash communications without replacing your existing systems.

Key Discussion Points
- Volos Energy currently receives inquiries and orders through phone calls, emails, and WhatsApp interactions.
- Your team is actively running Meta/Facebook marketing campaigns to generate leads and build market awareness.
- ZoTok can help:
  - Capture and qualify leads generated through Meta/Facebook campaigns.
  - Automate customer interactions on WhatsApp using AI-powered responses.
  - Share product catalogs, quotations, technical specifications, invoices, and ledger information instantly.
  - Run WhatsApp marketing campaigns and provide detailed engagement analytics.
  - Support multilingual conversations and convert handwritten or voice-based requests into structured business transactions.
  - Integrate with existing business applications through APIs or SFTP if required.

Recommended Approach
Considering your current stage of business growth and customer base, we discussed starting with:
1. Lead Management & Marketing Automation
  - Capture leads from Meta Ads directly into ZoTok.
  - Automatically qualify and route leads for follow-up.

emails.subject: Re: Zotok- Zook Spaces Pvt Ltd
emails.body:
Dear Pradyumn Ji,

Thank you for taking the time to walk us through your business operations and current order management process. It was insightful to understand your B2B vegetable distribution model and the scale at which your team is operating.

Based on our discussion, below is a summary of the key challenges identified and how ZoTok can help automate and streamline your business processes.

Current Business Challenges
- Customer orders are received through individual WhatsApp chats and WhatsApp groups.
- Orders are manually consolidated into Excel sheets for processing and vendor communication.
- The team spends significant effort every night processing and sorting orders manually.
- High transaction volumes, ranging from approximately 1,000-2,000 orders per day, create operational challenges.
- Business conversations, orders, dispatches, and payment discussions are spread across multiple WhatsApp groups, making tracking and visibility difficult.
- Lack of a centralized platform to manage orders, customer interactions, and reporting.

ZoTok Solution Demonstrated
1. WhatsApp Order Automation: capture orders from WhatsApp chats and groups; convert unstructured messages into structured orders; read and process handwritten order formats; reduce manual order entry.
2. Automated Order Confirmation: instant acknowledgement, confirmation and status updates to customers.
3. Product Recognition Engine: identify products from local names/abbreviations and map them to the product master.
4. Multilingual Conversational AI: multiple regional languages with automatic language detection.
5. WhatsApp Group Intelligence: analyze business WhatsApp groups, categorize into orders, dispatches, payments, collections and queries, and generate dashboards.
6. Customer Self-Service: share invoices and payment information on WhatsApp; respond to queries instantly.
7. Dashboard & Reporting: order, sales, invoice reports and item-wise analytics.
8. Integration Flexibility: Google Sheets for immediate deployment; future ERP integration as processes mature.

Key Business Benefits
- Significant reduction in manual order processing efforts.
- Faster order turnaround and customer communication.
- Better visibility into order, dispatch, and payment discussions.
- Improved operational efficiency and scalability.
- Business teams can focus on sales and growth rather than manual data processing.

Recommended Initial Scope
- WhatsApp Order Capture & Automation
- WhatsApp Group Intelligence
- Handwritten Order Recognition
- Order Approval Workflow
- Customer Notifications & Status Updates
- Google Sheets Integration
- Reporting & Analytics Dashboard

As discussed, we will share a commercial proposal and budgetary quotation for your review. We look forward to working closely with your team to identify the most suitable deployment approach and help automate your order-to-cash operations at scale.

Please feel free to share any additional requirements or priorities that you would like us to consider while preparing the proposal.

Ravi Kishore
Senior Sales Manager
Zotok | ZONO Tradetech Private Limited
